evidence.reason: The finding identifies a real correctness bug. `expectationChangesOf` shifts one queued removed line for every added line. In an edit block that inserts non-assertion lines before a rewritten assertion, those insertions consume the queued removed lines, so the re-added assertion is compared with the wrong line or with `undefined` and no `ExpectationChange` is recorded. That hides a changed test oracle, which this gate is intended to report. The same-block boundary and trimmed-difference behavior can be preserved by pairing re-added assertion-shaped lines with the earliest unmatched removed assertion-shaped line in the block.
